title: Gradient Text
description: Apply a vibrant gradient to text.

title: Soft Text Shadow

title: Animated Underline
description: Reveal an underline when a link is hovered.

title: Custom Selection

title: Glassmorphism Card
description: Create a translucent frosted-glass surface.

title: Soft UI Shadow
description: Subtle raised surface using layered shadows.

title: Gradient Border
description: A crisp gradient border without extra elements.

title: Neon Glow
description: Build a glowing accent with box-shadow.

title: Image Overlay
description: Layer a readable gradient over an image.

title: Blend Mode Text
description: Use mix-blend-mode for layered visual effects.
css:
.blend-stage { padding: 30px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #e879f9, #67e8f9); }
.blend-stage span { color: white; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 900; mix-blend-mode: difference; }

title: Hover Lift
description: Lift a card gently when the pointer enters.

title: Button Press
description: Give buttons a tactile pressed state.

title: Accessible Focus Ring
description: Make keyboard focus visible and consistent.
css:
.focus-button { padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #718096; border-radius: 8px; background: #18243a; color: white; }
.focus-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a4f06a; outline-offset: 4px; }

title: Smooth Scrolling
description: Enable smooth in-page navigation.
html:
Jump down ↓
You made it.

title: CSS Tooltip
description: Show helpful context on hover and focus.
html: <button class="tip" data-tip="A helpful little hint">Hover or focus</button>

title: Skeleton Loading
description: A shimmer placeholder for loading content.

title: Spin Animation
description: A reusable continuous rotation animation.
css:
.spinner { width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 5px solid #344258; border-top-color: #a4f06a; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 1s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

title: Pulse Animation
description: Draw attention with a soft pulsing scale.
css:
.pulse-dot { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: #a4f06a; animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 50% { transform: scale(1.22); opacity: .55; } }

title: Floating Element
description: A gentle vertical floating motion.
css:
.float-orb { width: 55px; height: 55px; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#a4f06a,#73d9df); animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes float { 50% { transform: translateY(-15px); } }

title: Reduced Motion Safe
description: Respect visitors who request less motion.

title: Visually Hidden Text
description: Hide text visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.
css:
.icon-only { width: 42px; height: 42px; border: 1px solid #52647c; border-radius: 9px; background: #18243a; color: white; font-size: 22px; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

title: Color Scheme Support
description: Adapt native form controls to the active color scheme.
html: Native controls follow the theme
css: .scheme-demo { color: #eaf0f8; padding: 20px; background: #18243a; border-radius: 10px; color-scheme: dark; }

title: Custom Checkbox
description: Style a checkbox while preserving native semantics.
html: <label class="check-demo"><input type="checkbox" checked> I agree to the terms</label>
css:
.check-demo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #eaf0f8; font-size: 13px; }
.check-demo input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: #a4f06a; }

title: Input Focus State
description: Give form fields a clear focus treatment.
css:
.pretty-input { width: 100%; max-width: 280px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid #52647c; border-radius: 9px; outline: none; background: #101827; color: white; }
.pretty-input:focus { border-color: #a4f06a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #a4f06a25; }

title: Accent Range Slider
description: Use accent-color to theme native range controls.
css:
.range-demo { display: grid; gap: 12px; color: #eaf0f8; font-size: 12px; width: 220px; }
.range-demo input { width: 100%; accent-color: #a4f06a; cursor: pointer; }

title: Custom Scrollbar
description: Style scrollbars where the browser supports it.
html:
Scroll to explore this custom scrollbar.

CSS can make small interface details feel intentional.

Keep scrollbar contrast accessible.

More content lives here.

title: Image Object Fit
description: Crop images consistently inside fixed dimensions.
css:
.image-frame { width: 180px; height: 110px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; }
.fake-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(130deg,#315a55,#273b68); color: white; font-weight: 800; object-fit: cover; }

title: Container Query
description: Let a component respond to its own container width.
html: Resize the preview to test

title: Flex Sticky Footer
description: Push a footer to the bottom on short pages.

title: Backdrop Blur
description: Blur the content behind a translucent overlay.
css:
.backdrop-scene { min-height: 140px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#263b5a 0 12px,#476a63 12px 24px); }
.backdrop-panel { padding: 18px 25px; color: white; background: #ffffff30; border: 1px solid #ffffff66; border-radius: 10px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }

title: Clip-path Shape
description: Create geometric shapes without image assets.
css: .clip-shape { width: 120px; height: 100px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#a4f06a,#73d9df); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }

title: CSS Marquee
description: Create a looping text ticker; pause it on hover.

title: Rounded Squircle
description: Use large corner radii for a soft squircle-like surface.
css: .squircle { width: 125px; height: 90px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#a4f06a,#73d9df); color: #10170c; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; }

title: CSS Counter
description: Automatically number repeated elements with counters.

title: :has() Parent Selector
description: Style a parent based on the state of its child.
